Office established for Vermont towns by 17 V.S.A. section 2646 (moderator, elected annually). No official source found as of 2026-10-17 publishes the current Arlington holder; the post is created as structure only and the membership awaits the printed annual town report or a clerk records reply.

Office established for Vermont towns by 17 V.S.A. section 2646 (auditors elected at annual meeting; three serve staggered three-year terms under section 2651. A town may vote to eliminate the office and engage a public accountant under section 2651b; whether this town has done so is not determinable from published sources).
